chapters.reason: The paper introduces Gated DeltaNet, which utilizes a delta update rule and gating mechanism within a linear-state recurrence framework, similar to Mamba2 and DeltaNet.
The architecture uses a compressive memory mechanism with a delta update rule, which is directly related to the Infini-attention paradigm of constant-memory streaming.
The paper discusses hybrid architectures that combine Gated DeltaNet with existing models, effectively replacing or augmenting standard Transformer layers with recurrent state-space mixers.
